securityReview.reportedDescription: This site has been flagged for malicious behavior.

verificationMethods: Thirty anonymous HTTP GETs on the exact immutable deploy host with no cookies and manual redirects.
Authorized Netlify per-deploy file API for exact bytes of eleven critical app assets and netlify.toml; no tester session created.
All eighty-one local distribution files compared with deployed inventory SHA1 and size, with SHA256 checks of critical raw bytes.
Original source ZIP downloaded using Netlify-provided temporary URL without forwarding API authorization; SHA256 matches submitted archive.
Production published deploy ID checked before the build and after hosted artifact verification.
limits: No genuine tester login or interactive hosted wallet/gameplay session was performed.
No Slush clearance, false-positive determination, or verification of the new hostname in Slush was obtained.
The earlier offline fixture browser review establishes local UI behavior; these checks establish deployed code and access controls.
